scope: Independent inverse-matrix projection and convex-hull/SAT comparison of both complete32-facet shaft/cone parts acquired by source replay. Observed GPU PNGs are complementary; vertices are not a GPU buffer readback. Collinear/edge-on vectors are not claimed separately distinguishable.
